newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL overnight rises to 7.5/7 pct on flow mismatch.
newsitem.headline: KL overnight rises to 7.5/7 pct on flow mismatch.

text.p: The overnight interbank rate rose to 7.50/70 percent due to a mismatch in funds availability after banks paid one billion ringgit for two Bank Negara bill issues, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said there was a maturity of 500 million ringgit in Bank Negara bills on Wednesday. Another 500 million ringgit maturity will take place on Friday, they said.
"Everybody knew that Bank Negara is just rolling over the maturing bills, but I think some people were not aware that the maturities were spread out this week," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
"It is just a flow mismatch. The overnight will be slightly tight till Friday," the dealer said.
But, dealers said the impact will be limited since the market was relatively flush before the payment for the bills.
The market has been liquid since Monday when a Bank Negara deposit matured. The maturity pulled down the overnight rate to 6.0 percent from 8.0 percent last week.

The fund which had eased liquidity in the system was raised as part of Bank Negara's open market intervention. It regularly intervenes in the money market to control liquidity and set interest rates, but does not reveal the amount mopped up.
Earlier, short-term interbank rates eased due to the liquidity, dealers said.
The one-week interbank rate fell to 6.90/7.10 percent against 7.00/20, two-week was steady at 7.10/20 and one-month to 7.18/20 against 7.20/25.
Three-month money was trading at 7.25 percent against 7.25/30 and six-month was offered at 7.28. There was no bid.
Dealers said the market was dealing cautiously to avoid any sharp decline in rates that could attract central bank intervention.
Dealers said the market was being cautious after interbank rates refused to budge despite a 500 million ringgit Bank Negara bill maturity last Friday.
Interbank liquidity is expected to improve further on November 25, when a central bank intervention deposit is expected to mature.
